title: How Many Categories Are Enough? Distribution-Free Certification Limits for Few-Shot Anomaly Thresholds
abstract: arXiv:2610.00236v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Few-shot anomaly detectors are judged by ranking metrics, yet deployment requires an alarm threshold with a controlled false-alarm rate (FAR). We ask how much normal evidence, in images or category units, is needed to certify such a threshold for an unseen category. Using a frozen DINOv2 principal component analysis (PCA) residual ranker on 15 MVTec and 12 VisA categories under four corruption types, we show that target-only leave-one-image-out (LOIO) calibration is resolution-limited and shift-fragile: rank values cannot fall below $1/(k+1)$, and at the attainable level $\alpha=0.20$, empirical FAR reaches 0.341 on Gaussian-corrupted MVTec at $k=4$, 1.7 times the nominal level. translated_title: 多少类别才足够？少样本异常检测阈值的免分布认证极限
translated_abstract: 少样本异常检测器通常以排序类指标来评价，但实际部署需要一个具有可控误报率（FAR）的报警阈值。我们提出的问题是：需要多少正常证据——以图像数或类别数计——才能为未见过的类别认证这样一个阈值。我们在 15 个 MVTec 类别和 12 个 VisA 类别上，使用冻结的 DINOv2 主成分分析（PCA）残差排序器，并在四种损坏类型下进行实验，结果表明仅针对目标类别的留一图像（LOIO）校准受限于分辨率且对分布漂移脆弱：排序值不可能低于 $1/(k+1)$，在可达到的水平 $\alpha=0.20$ 下，高斯损坏的 MVTec 数据集在 $k=4$ 时的经验误报率达到 0.341，为名义水平的 1.7 倍。随后我们推导出一个类别数量的可行性计算方法：即使所有类别损失均为零且不计多重性代价，任何确定性的、一致有效的、免分布的 95% 置信上界（UCB）都需要至少 14、29 和 59 个独立同分布……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明少样本异常检测中仅用目标类别校准报警阈值存在分辨率下限且对分布漂移脆弱，并从理论上推导出免分布认证所需最少独立同分布类别数的可行性下界（95% 置信上界至少需要 14、29、59 个类别）。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that target-only calibration of few-shot anomaly thresholds is resolution-limited and shift-fragile, and derives distribution-free lower bounds on the number of i.i.d. categories required to certify a threshold (at least 14, 29, and 59 categories for a 95% UCB).
